description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tables that extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule. The class sets up HTML purification rules and element definitions related to table elements in XHTML 1.1, including elements like <table>, <caption>, <tr>, <td>, <th>, <col>, <colgroup>, <tbody>, <thead>, and <tfoot>.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tables
classes.description: A class that sets up accessible and standards-compliant HTML table elements and attributes for XHTML 1.1.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the table-related HTML elements and their attributes for the purifier configuration.
